verdict.rationale: IRCC is a government immigration services portal covering work permits, visas, processing times and accounts. It is not an AI agent or assistant host that could act as an MCP client and consume other servers' tools, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests it ships any MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
